outline: 1388 Mental Shortcuts for Adding and Subtracting Integers

examples.solution_text:
(a) Divide the product by the known factor.
$54\div6=9$, so $\square=9$.
Check: $6\times9=54$.
(b) Multiply the quotient by the divisor.
$8\times7=56$, so $\square=56$.
Check: $56\div7=8$.
(c) Divide the dividend by the quotient.
$72\div9=8$, so $\square=8$.
Check: $72\div8=9$.

(a) Divide the product by the known factor.
$63\div9=7$, so $\square=7$.
Check: $9\times7=63$.
(b) Divide the dividend by the quotient.
$84\div7=12$, so $\square=12$.
Check: $84\div12=7$.

(a) Divide the product by the known factor.
$144\div12=12$, so $\square=12$.
Check: $12\times12=144$.
(b) Multiply the quotient by the divisor.
$15\times6=90$, so $\square=90$.
Check: $90\div6=15$.
